note: Row-by-row before-images for the pdc_for_eng patch-ahead pass, 2026-08-11. Reverse by setting course_seeds.target_text back to before_target_text for the given id.

rows.before_target_text: Bischt du reddi, fer mit em neegscht Bus heemgeh?
rows.after_target_text: Bischt du reddi, fer mit em naegscht Bus heemgeh?
rows.known_text: Are you ready to go home on the next bus?

rows.before_target_text: Fer was kann ich mich net erinnere, was du gsaat hascht?
rows.after_target_text: Fer was kann ich mich net erinnere, was du gsaat hoscht?
rows.known_text: Why can't I remember what you said?

rows.before_target_text: Die Aerwet do iss die Form vun meim Gehann am ennere.
rows.after_target_text: Die Arewet do iss die Form vun meim Gehann am ennere.
rows.known_text: This work is changing the shape of my brain.

rows.before_target_text: Witt du die neegscht Woch iwwer ebbes anners schwetze?
rows.after_target_text: Witt du die naegscht Woch iwwer ebbes anners schwetze?
rows.known_text: Do you want to talk about something different next week?

rows.before_target_text: Deetscht du gleiche neegscht Munet mit uns kumme?
rows.after_target_text: Deetscht du gleiche naegscht Munet mit uns kumme?
rows.known_text: Would you like to come with us next month?

rows.before_target_text: Ya, ich hab frieh neegscht Woch en wichdichi Meeting.
rows.after_target_text: Ya, ich hab frieh naegscht Woch en wichdichi Meeting.
rows.known_text: Yes I've got an important meeting early next week.

rows.before_target_text: Er hat gsaat, as er dir ebbes weise will.
rows.after_target_text: Er hot gsaat, as er dir ebbes weise will.
rows.known_text: He said that he wants to show you something.

rows.before_target_text: Sie hat gsaat, as sie net in ere Schtadt wuhne will.
rows.after_target_text: Sie hot gsaat, as sie net in ere Schtadt wuhne will.
rows.known_text: She said that she doesn't want to live in a city.

rows.before_target_text: Er hat wisse wolle, was en Woch zerick am gschehe waar.
rows.after_target_text: Er hot wisse wolle, was en Woch zerick am gschehe waar.
rows.known_text: He wanted to know what was happening a week ago.

rows.before_target_text: Sie hat net wisse wolle, was gschehe deet.
rows.after_target_text: Sie hot net wisse wolle, was gschehe deet.
rows.known_text: She didn't want to know what was going to happen.

rows.before_target_text: Ya, er hat deel alte Freind sehne wolle.
rows.after_target_text: Ya, er hot deel alte Freind sehne wolle.
rows.known_text: Yes he wanted to see some old friends.

rows.before_target_text: Nee, er hat mich net allee losse wolle.
rows.after_target_text: Nee, er hot mich net allee losse wolle.
rows.known_text: No he didn't want to leave me on my own.

rows.before_target_text: Sie hat um's Feld rum schpringe gemusst.
rows.after_target_text: Sie hot um's Feld rum schpringe gemusst.
rows.known_text: She needed to run around the field.

rows.before_target_text: Ya, es hat ihn gegluscht, viel schwetze.
rows.after_target_text: Ya, es hot ihn gegluscht, viel schwetze.
rows.known_text: Yes he felt like talking a lot.

rows.before_target_text: Nee, kenner hat mir's gsaat.
rows.after_target_text: Nee, kenner hot mir's gsaat.
rows.known_text: No nobody told me.

rows.before_target_text: Nee, ich hab net genunk Geld ghat fer Vacation.
rows.after_target_text: Nee, ich hab net genunk Geld ghatt fer Vacation.
rows.known_text: No I didn't have enough money for holidays.

rows.before_target_text: Nee, ich hab net gedenkt, as sie recht ghat hot.
rows.after_target_text: Nee, ich hab net gedenkt, as sie recht ghatt hot.
rows.known_text: No I didn't think she was right.

rows.before_target_text: Nee, ich bin sicher, es zeelt okay sei.
rows.after_target_text: Nee, ich bin sicher, es waerd okay sei.
rows.known_text: No I'm sure it will be okay.

rows.before_target_text: Es neegscht Mol zeel ich sie frooge, was ihre Naame iss.
rows.after_target_text: Es naegscht Mol waer ich sie frooge, was ihre Naame iss.
rows.known_text: Next time I will ask her what her name is.

rows.before_target_text: Dann zeel ich nie widder niemand traue.
rows.after_target_text: Dann waer ich nie widder niemand traue.
rows.known_text: Then I will never trust anyone ever again.

rows.before_target_text: Ich zeel iwwer's Graas schpringe.
rows.after_target_text: Ich waer iwwer's Graas schpringe.
rows.known_text: I'm going to run across the grass.

rows.before_target_text: Ich hab gheert, as du zeelscht fer en nei Bett bezaahle.
rows.after_target_text: Ich hab gheert, as du waerrscht fer en nei Bett bezaahle.
rows.known_text: I heard that you're going to pay for a new bed.

rows.before_target_text: Es hett der ganze Familye happene kenne.
rows.after_target_text: Es hett der ganze Familye gschehe kenne.
rows.known_text: It might have happened to the whole family.

rows.before_target_text: Ich bin bang, as du vergesse zeelscht, fer was mir do hen bleiwe misse.
rows.after_target_text: Ich bin bang, as du vergesse waerrscht, fer was mir do hen bleiwe misse.
rows.known_text: I'm afraid that you'll forget why we needed to stay here.

rows.before_target_text: Ich zeel dich in drei odder vier Minudde zerickruufe.
rows.after_target_text: Ich waer dich in drei odder vier Minudde zerickruufe.
rows.known_text: I'll call you back in three or four minutes.

rows.before_target_text: fer tschecke, eb du hascht fattich waerre kenne
rows.after_target_text: fer tschecke, eb du hoscht fattich waerre kenne
rows.known_text: To check if you've been able to finish.

rows.before_target_text: Sie zeelt net uff yedes Watt hariche, as du saagscht.
rows.after_target_text: Sie waerd net uff yedes Watt hariche, as du saagscht.
rows.known_text: She won't listen to every word you say.

rows.before_target_text: Es iss schee gewest, Zeit dausse schpende un die Kinner schpiele sehne.
rows.after_target_text: Es iss schee gewest, Zeit dausse verbringe un die Kinner schpiele sehne.
rows.known_text: It's been lovely spending time outdoors watching the children play.

rows.before_target_text: Ich bin am expecte fer en Improvement sehne, es negscht Mol as mir zammekumme.
rows.after_target_text: Ich bin am expecte fer en Improvement sehne, es naegscht Mol as mir zammekumme.
rows.known_text: I'm expecting to see an improvement next time we meet.

rows.before_target_text: Wie viel witt du fer dei Kaarde zaahle?
rows.after_target_text: Wie viel witt du fer dei Kaarde bezaahle?
rows.known_text: How much are you willing to pay for your ticket?

rows.before_target_text: Sie hot als druff bschtanne, as mir Oier ghat hen fer's Owedesse.
rows.after_target_text: Sie hot als druff bschtanne, as mir Oier ghatt hen fer's Owedesse.
rows.known_text: She used to insist that we had eggs for supper.

rows.before_target_text: Ich waer gfaahre, wann du mir gsaat hettscht, wie mied as du warscht.
rows.after_target_text: Ich waer gfaahre, wann du mir gsaat hettscht, wie mied as du waarscht.
rows.known_text: I'd have driven if you'd told me how tired you were.

rows.before_target_text: Wann ich sellemols gwisst hett, was ich nau wees, hett ich gwaart.
rows.after_target_text: Wann ich sellemols gwisst hett, was ich nau weess, hett ich gwaart.
rows.known_text: If I'd known then what I know now I'd have waited.
